items.title: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview Is Out & It Was Built With AI
items.excerpt: Epic's UE 5.9 Preview ships AI workflow enhancements (agent tools, Unreal Canvas generation) plus web platform, rendering and animation updates; Epic says the preview itself was built largely with AI.

items.title: AI機能フル投入の「Unreal Engine 5.9」プレビュー版が配信開始。「UE6」を前に、“AIフレンドリー”なゲームエンジンへと様変わり
items.excerpt: Epic released the Unreal Engine 5.9 MegaJam Preview on Nov 10, loading the editor with AI features ahead of UE6 and reshaping it into an 'AI-friendly' engine.

items.title: Unreal Engineに生成AI機能が続々。「Unreal Canvas」搭載の5.9プレビュー版が公開
items.excerpt: UE 5.9 Preview, released for the Epic AI MegaJam, adds Unreal Canvas, which generates images and 3D asset ideas from the scene in progress; Epic says AI was used to build the preview.

items.title: House House clarifies use of AI tools in Big Walk's "final stage of development"
items.excerpt: House House issued a statement on AI tool use in Big Walk after a group of 2027 IGF jurors said they would decline to vote for games that used generative AI during development.

items.title: Under pressure, Big Walk developer House House apologises for using generative AI
items.excerpt: Big Walk, one of 2026's indie standouts, was made with limited help from generative AI; the studio says it used LLMs sparingly for bug fixing without an internal policy and calls that a mistake.

items.title: Big Walk AI Controversy Is a GOTY Awards Twist Sparking a Bigger Debate
items.excerpt: The Big Walk disclosure and IGF jury stance turn awards season into a test of where the industry draws the line on generative-AI use in development.

items.title: Some IGF Jurors Are 'Declining To Vote For Any Game That Uses Generative AI In Any Capacity'
items.excerpt: A group of IGF 2027 jurors published a statement refusing to vote for any game that used generative AI in development, the trigger for the Big Walk disclosure.

items.title: ゲーム日本語化ツール「PCOT」次のアプデで開発終了へ。AIの進化で“セルフ直接日本語化”の未来が見えたため
items.excerpt: Solo developer nurupo is ending the long-running game translation-assist tool PCOT after its next update, saying AI has made players' self-service direct Japanese localization the future.

items.title: ゲーム向け翻訳支援ツール「PCOT」開発終了へ。AIを使ってプレイヤー自身で日本語化する未来が見えたため
items.excerpt: The game translation-assist tool PCOT will end development with its current update, as its creator sees AI letting players localize games into Japanese themselves.

items.title: Educational game dev program cancelled because students were submitting games made entirely with AI
items.excerpt: An educational game-development program was cancelled because growing generative-AI use made it 'harder to judge what students made themselves.'

items.title: 'AMDLSS5' gets Nvidia's neural rendering running on AMD graphics cards
items.excerpt: AMDLSS5 v2.0, a mod that runs Nvidia's machine-learning DLSS 5 neural rendering on AMD RX 9000-series GPUs, claims 64% better performance than earlier mods.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 Builds Playable Gears of War: E-Day Clone From Three-Line Prompt
items.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 built a playable Unreal Engine Gears of War clone from a three-line prompt, but the project consumed about 8.5 billion tokens.

items.title: 엔비디아 GPU에 국산 NPU 붙인다…'배그' AI 팀원이 보여준 추론 경쟁
items.excerpt: At NVIDIA AI Day Seoul, NVIDIA paired its GPUs with Korean NPUs; the piece uses KRAFTON's on-PC PUBG AI teammate to show why inference latency and behaviour control now matter to players.

items.title: 최석원 컴투스플랫폼 대표 "'하이브 액실'로 글로벌 공략⋯백엔드 연동 AI로 처리"
items.excerpt: Com2uS Platform's Hive Axil game backend is built to be AI-readable so agents can handle backend integration almost without humans; Unreal, Godot and HTML5 support expands in early 2027.

items.title: 10 tips for organizing your first video game project with AI
items.excerpt: Unity's guide for building a game by prompting Unity Spark, its browser-based AI game-creation platform: design briefs, naming, checkpoints, prompt logs and playtesting, no code needed.

items.title: [인터뷰] AI 시대 인디게임 제작을 위한 요시다 슈헤이의 조언
items.excerpt: Former PlayStation indie chief Shuhei Yoshida says AI can supplement scarce dev resources, visuals and localization for Korean indies, but new ideas and gameplay remain the creator's job.

items.title: Ahead of GTA 6 and as concerns over genAI PC ports grow, Take-Two's CEO says they're revving up their "technical defences" and "legal activites"
items.excerpt: Take-Two's Strauss Zelnick says the publisher is stepping up technical defences and legal action as AI-generated recompilations and unofficial PC ports threaten GTA 6.
